frame_width.doc: Width of the frame a service crops to

site.doc: Which plant this deployment runs at. factory_c is deliberately NOT covered by the container derive table: a partial table implies nothing about the values it omits.

mode.doc: Whether the edge service is included. Two values so 'not x' is a reachable state and the guarded accepts conjunct can be shown to assert nothing. Defaults to the arm that EXCLUDES the edge service, so a resolve that names only the site still completes.

containers.doc: The physical containers this plant runs on the line.
